name: spreadsheetGetCellFormat
description: Returns the formatting of a single cell in the active sheet of a spreadsheet workbook as a struct with the same keys the format methods accept: bold, italic, fontsize, font, color, bgcolor, alignment, verticalalignment, wraptext and dataformat (number format code). Colours are returned as #RRGGBB hex strings. Keys are only present when the style sets them. Rows and columns are 1-based. The fluent member form is getCellFormat(row, column).

examples.title: Read back a format
examples.description: Format a cell, then read the format struct back.
